device_entry.description: 用于控制 Mecademic 六轴机械臂及其末端工具的机器人系统，可执行关节与笛卡尔运动、夹爪抓取、真空吸附、I/O 控制、程序运行和实时状态监测，适用于实验室自动化中的取放、定位、转运与样品处理。
device_entry.description_en: A robotic system for controlling a Mecademic six-axis robotic arm and its end tools. It supports joint and Cartesian motion, gripper handling, vacuum pick-up, I/O control, program execution, and real-time monitoring for laboratory automation tasks such as pick-and-place, positioning, transfer, and sample handling.
